verdict.rationale: AutoGen is a Python framework whose documented public API is its library interface: installable packages, documented classes such as AssistantAgent, RoundRobinGroupChat and SelectorGroupChat, and programmatic calls like agent.run(task=...). AutoGen Studio also mentions setting up endpoints from a team configuration. Coverage is only partial because no API reference or HTTP/OpenAPI spec is evidenced (probes for openapi.json returned 404), and the Studio endpoint feature is a single thin mention. missing for 10: a published API reference or OpenAPI/HTTP API spec, detailed documentation of the Studio endpoint feature, independent corroboration of driving the product programmatically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
